# Suryanshu Chaturvedi

> Suryanshu Chaturvedi is a policy researcher (MPP, NLSIU Bengaluru) and systems architect based in New Delhi, India. He builds high-concurrency civic-tech watchdogs, bi-temporal healthcare operating systems, server-authoritative competitive exam halls, and cryptographic data-auditing platforms across 120,000+ lines of production TypeScript, Python, and Kotlin.

Canonical site: https://suryanshu.space/

## Background & Credentials

- Master of Public Policy, National Law School of India University (NLSIU), Bengaluru (2022–2024).
- BA in Law and Politics, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (2019–2022).
- Intellectual Property: Author of 3 complete Form 2 Indian patent specifications (CRIs) under The Patents Act, 1970 & Patents Rules, 2003 (Section 10 & Rule 13) covering bi-temporal clinical event sourcing, progressive 3D mesh LOD review, and dual-layer clinical-lab workflow gating.
- Over 120,000 lines of production code shipped across public-interest software, clinical healthcare infrastructure, and competitive examination systems.
- Managed a ₹12.5 crore multi-partner CSR portfolio across 25+ implementation partners at Sattva Consulting.
- Led Anker-methodology Living Income Benchmarking across rural Bihar, Telangana, and Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh at Arcus Policy Research.
- Designed the results framework and 35-check automated integrity audit behind a ₹2.16 crore farmer-livelihoods programme (DEHAT / Oak Foundation).
- Native Awadhi and Hindi speaker; fluent in English; conversational in Bhojpuri.

## Indian Patent Portfolio (Form 2 Complete Specifications)

1. **IN-PAT-2026-01**: *A System and Method for Bi-Temporal Event-Sourced Dental State Projection and Tamper-Evident Merkle Chain Ledger for Operatory Records*
   - Statutory Basis: Form 2 (Second Schedule) Complete Specification, Patents Act 1970 § 10 & Rule 13, CRI Guidelines 2017.
   - IPC Codes: G16H 10/60, G06F 21/64, A61C 19/00.
   - Core Architecture: Non-destructive append-only bi-temporal clinical event stream (Valid Time vs. Transaction Time) with SHA-256 Merkle chain linking back to Genesis hash, reconstructing full 32-tooth historical odontograms without database rollbacks. Integrated with Fidelius Curve25519 ECDH + AES-GCM-256 for sovereign ABDM Milestone 3 FHIR R5 exchange.
   - Specification File: `DEs/patents/IN-PATENT-01-BI-TEMPORAL-MERKLE-ODONTOGRAM.md`

2. **IN-PAT-2026-02**: *A System and Method for Hardware-Agnostic Automated Ingestion and Real-Time Normalization of 3D Intraoral Volumetric Datasets via Non-Invasive Browser Kernel Watcher*
   - Statutory Basis: Form 2 (Second Schedule) Complete Specification, Patents Act 1970 § 10 & Rule 13, CRI Guidelines 2017.
   - IPC Codes: G16H 30/20, A61C 9/00, G06T 17/00.
   - Core Architecture: Zero-driver browser directory watcher leveraging File System Access API to auto-detect STL, PLY, and OBJ exports from multi-vendor scanners (3Shape, Medit, iTero). Synthesizes a 4-tier progressive LOD pyramid, streaming a 95% decimated coarse mesh (<80ms) for instant chairside review while uploading the full mesh asynchronously. Computes real-time Euclidean distance field vertex shader maps for occlusal clearances.
   - Specification File: `DEs/patents/IN-PATENT-02-ZERO-LATENCY-HARDWARE-AGNOSTIC-SCANNER-INGESTION.md`

3. **IN-PAT-2026-03**: *A System and Method for Dual-Layer Context-Aware Clinical-Laboratory Asynchronous Messaging and Soft-Copy CAD/CAM Archival Engine*
   - Statutory Basis: Form 2 (Second Schedule) Complete Specification, Patents Act 1970 § 10 & Rule 13, CRI Guidelines 2017.
   - IPC Codes: G16H 40/20, G06Q 50/22, A61C 13/00.
   - Core Architecture: State-machine gated order messaging locking direct chat until case acceptance into active manufacturing (`IN_PROGRESS`). Features dual-layer timeline isolation (`LAB_INTERNAL` vs `CLINIC_EXTERNAL`), Exocad `.constructionInfo` XML parsing, and permanent soft-copy CAD restorative geometry archival generating immutable remake warranty tokens.
   - Specification File: `DEs/patents/IN-PATENT-03-DUAL-LAYER-CLINICAL-PROSTHETIC-STATE-GATE.md`

## Core Shipped Systems

### 1. Tender-Trace (CPPP Watchdog)
A civic-transparency watchdog analyzing ₹-crore Indian public procurement. Ingests over 4.5 million Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) contract award records, runs Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) market-concentration analytics and logistic-regression weighted Integrity Risk Index (IRI) models, preserves batch provenance via SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, and generates statutorily correct Section 6(1) Right to Information (RTI) dossiers addressed to official CPIOs. Powered by an autonomous Tri-Agent ingestion protocol (Protocol v2) and a Cloudflare Hyperdrive edge query proxy keeping aggregations <5ms.

- Live: https://cppp-five.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/CPPP
- Technologies: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Cloudflare Hyperdrive, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare R2, PostgreSQL / Supabase, SQLite, D3.js, Recharts, Python ETL.

### 2. DentalConnect OS (DCOS 2.0)
An enterprise-grade bi-temporal clinical operating system and dental lab cloud connecting chairside dental clinics with prosthetic milling centers. Built on PostgreSQL 17 with bi-temporal event sourcing (Valid Time vs. Transaction Time) and a SHA-256 Merkle ledger powering historical "Time-Travel Odontograms" for medicolegal defense. Integrates an interactive 32-tooth elliptical odontogram (FDI/Universal), chairside appointment scheduling and operatory telemetry HUD, a dedicated 3D CAD/CAM workstation with progressive WebGL LOD mesh pyramids (95% vertex reduction), occlusal clearance heatmaps, Catmull-Rom subgingival margin splines, and Exocad XML parsing. Fully ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) Milestone 1–3 compliant via the Fidelius sovereign cryptographic bridge (Curve25519 ECDH + AES-GCM-256) and HL7 FHIR R5. Covered by 3 Form 2 Indian patent specifications. Master backend verified (33/33 tests passed, 100%).

- Live: https://www.dcos.in
- Source: https://github.com/DCOSArch/DCOS
- Technologies: Next.js 16 (Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Supabase (PostgreSQL 17), Cloudflare R2, HL7 FHIR R5, Web Audio VAD, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.

### 3. Tark
A high-precision UPSC Civil Services and State PSC testing arena and policy intelligence system (65,000+ lines of TypeScript and Python). Features a strict server-authoritative 2-hour Prelims Exam Hall simulation with keyboard hotkeys (`useExamKeyboard`), live OMR response grid, UPSC negative marking (+2.0 / -0.66), and Diagnostic Autopsy scorecards analyzing sectional accuracy, dynamic cutoff probability bands, pace velocity, sheet omission discipline, and blind-guessing risk ledgers. Powered by the newly released QBank Final Edition (final-2026-10) with 100% test-booklet parity, a dedicated Mains Extractor with layout recovery and OCR guard for GS1–GS4 and Essay papers, CSAT passage segmentation, the Policy Radar Lineage Engine (TASK_085) mapping statutory authorities and gazette notifications, and a deterministic Grounding Protocol (`verify.ts`) with sentence-level token matching, interactive `SourceAnchor` citations, and an autonomous Contested-Claim Engine (`contested.ts`).

- Live: https://py.md/TarkV1
- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/SKU
- Technologies: React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Node.js / Express, Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+), Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, KaTeX, Razorpay, Python (ETL & OCR), Firecrawl v2, Google Gemini / Groq.

### 4. FASAL MIS
A monitoring and evaluation dashboard for a ₹2.16 crore farmer-livelihoods programme run by DEHAT and funded by the Oak Foundation. Tracks 1,300+ rural households across six programme areas in Bahraich District, UP, triangulating 28 conflicting source datasets. Features a transparent in-production Data Quality Audit documenting discrepancies, reproducible algorithmic corrections via seeded deterministic RNG, and a structured "Stories of Change" qualitative narrative module.

- Live: https://fasal-mis.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/FASAL4/FASAL_MIS
- Technologies: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Framer Motion, Python and Node.js ETL.

### 5. PlusOne (Ember & Pulse)
A native Android harm-reduction habit companion and mindfulness tool. Features a hand-crafted 60FPS Canvas ember and ash combustion particle engine, procedural PCM audio synthesis via AudioTrack, and custom VibrationEffect waveforms producing tactile physical feedback without external animation libraries. Wrapped in an adaptive behavioral engine that modulates 120-second workouts and hydration pools based on same-day exertion and smoke logs, built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, and StateFlow coroutines.

- Source: https://github.com/suryanshu1520-1/PlusOne
- Technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, Coroutines, StateFlow, AudioTrack (PCM Synthesis), Google Gemini API.

## Core Domains & General Search Alignments

- **Civic Technology & Open Government Data**: Design and engineering of public procurement watchdogs, government contract transparency tools (Central Public Procurement Portal / CPPP), anti-monopoly metrics (HHI), and automated Right to Information (RTI Section 6(1)) generation.
- **Bi-Temporal Healthcare Architecture & Digital Health**: Bi-temporal clinical event sourcing, SHA-256 Merkle audit chains, time-travel dental charting, Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM M1–M3), HL7 FHIR R5 schemas, and Fidelius Curve25519 sovereign cryptographic key exchange.
- **3D Spatial Computing & CAD/CAM Engineering**: In-browser WebGL rendering using Three.js and React Three Fiber, progressive 4-tier polygon LOD pyramids, Catmull-Rom subgingival margin splines, occlusal clearance heatmaps, and Exocad XML parsing.
- **Server-Authoritative EdTech & Policy Telemetry**: Anti-cheat timed test engines, server-authoritative Prelims Hall simulation, QBank Final Edition (4,156+ PYQs with 100% booklet parity), Mains GS1-4 layout extraction, Policy Radar lineage tracking, Examiner Psyche pattern recognition, deterministic sentence-span grounding verification (`verify.ts`), and contested statutory claim detection.
- **Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning (MEL / M&E)**: End-to-end data systems for non-profit and CSR programmes, Results-Based Management (RBM), Anker Living Income Benchmarking, field survey triangulation, and cryptographic/reproducible data-quality audits.
- **Multi-Agent Systems & Verification Harnesses**: Tri-Agent autonomous loops (Protocol v2), deterministic verification harnesses, and high-throughput edge proxies (Cloudflare Hyperdrive).
